faq.q: Is it really a one-time payment?
faq.a: Yes. No subscription and no per-seat monthly fee. You pay once per license.
Nothing. sldev-io is free while it is in beta. When paid licenses launch, the prices on this page are the ones you will see.

faq.q: Do I need an account with every agent?
faq.a: sldev-io drives the agent CLIs that are already on your machine and uses their own logins. It never replaces your Claude, OpenAI, Cursor or GitHub subscription.
